title: FFmpeg glitch-order adapter: random → shuffleframes integration contract
purpose: Integration contract and adapter shell script for composing FFmpeg random (stochastic cache-flush) with shuffleframes (deterministic pattern reorder). Demonstrates the mechanical difference, shared interface, and a two-stage chain with explicit assumptions.
